The '''1973–74 Cypriot First Division''' was the 35th season of the Cypriot top-level [[Association football|football]] league.

==Overview==
It was contested by 14 teams, and [[AC Omonia]] won the championship. [[APOEL F.C.|APOEL]] participated in the [[1973–74 Alpha Ethniki|Greek championship]] as the previous year's champions. They finished in 14th position and were not relegated.
